_comment: Justified WCAG exceptions. Format: { theme: '<id>' | '*', pair: '<fgKey>/<bgKey>', reason }. Everything else must pass: text 4.5:1, ui 3:1.

reason: Background-on-background pair: a decorative fill for block quotes, not a boundary or text. Its text (foreground) is audited separately and passes.

Disabled controls are exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 (inactive user interface components). Tertiary label tier is deliberately de-emphasised (macOS tertiaryLabel ≈ 26 %; ours is 44–54 %) and still clears 3:1.
De-emphasised list rows (e.g. inactive/outdated items) — intentional de-emphasis, still ≥ 4:1 in dark and ≥ 3.9:1 in light; the primary label tier is used for all regular rows.
Ignored files are intentionally dimmed (the same tertiary tier as VS Code's own defaults, which sit near 3:1). Still ≥ 3:1.
Disabled control — exempt under WCAG 1.4.3; ≥ 3:1 in every variant.
Squiggle colour vs. editor background is a non-text UI indicator (3:1 target): 3.4:1 passes. The audit inventory tags the pair as text because the key name says Foreground.
Squiggle colour vs. editor background is a non-text UI indicator (3:1 target): 3.4:1 passes.
A progress bar fill vs. its track — non-text UI (3:1 target), passes at ≥ 4.2:1 in all variants.
